chunks.heading: Overview
chunks.text: Webhooks notify your server when events happen in Lighthouse. Supported event types include task.created, task.completed, and project.archived.

chunks.heading: Verifying webhook signatures
chunks.text:
# Lighthouse signs each payload in the X-Lighthouse-Signature header
expected = hmac_sha256(webhook_secret, request_body)
if not constant_time_equal(expected, header_value):
    reject_request()

chunks.heading: Retry behavior
chunks.text: If your endpoint does not return a 2xx response, Lighthouse retries delivery up to five times using exponential backoff, giving up after 24 hours of failed attempts.
